parameters.query:
SELECT t.*, c.name AS client_name, c.archetype, c.adversary, c.brand_goal,
  COALESCE(c.posts_per_week, 1) AS posts_per_week
FROM themes t
JOIN clients c ON c.id = t.client_id
WHERE t.id = $1
LIMIT 1

SELECT id, status FROM content_slots
WHERE theme_id = $1
  AND COALESCE(status, '') NOT IN ('archived', 'archive', 'deleted')
ORDER BY created_at ASC

SELECT posts_per_week, roles FROM content_rhythms
WHERE client_id = $1 AND active = 1
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS slot_count
FROM content_slots s
INNER JOIN themes t ON t.id = s.theme_id
WHERE s.client_id = $1
  AND COALESCE(s.status, '') NOT IN ('archived', 'archive', 'deleted')
  AND DATE(t.cycle_week) = DATE($2)

SELECT * FROM research_items
WHERE theme_id = $1
  AND COALESCE(feedback, 'none') != 'forgotten'
  AND (
    feedback = 'liked'
    OR NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM research_items r2
      WHERE r2.theme_id = $1 AND r2.feedback = 'liked'
    )
  )
ORDER BY created_at ASC
LIMIT 20

INSERT INTO content_slots (id, client_id, theme_id, status, phase_key, theme, goal, rhythm_role)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8)
